title: Glyx App Configuration
description: Configuration for a Glyx desktop application.

name.description: Application name used in build output and packaging.

width.description: Initial window width in logical pixels.

height.description: Initial window height in logical pixels.

minWidth.description: Minimum resizable width in logical pixels.

minHeight.description: Minimum resizable height in logical pixels.

resizable.description: Allow the user to resize the window.

decorations.description: Show native window decorations (title bar, borders). Set false to use a custom title bar with the WindowControls component.

icon.description: Path to the window and taskbar icon (PNG recommended, 256×256+).

capabilities.description: Declare the OS capabilities your app requires. Undeclared capabilities are blocked at runtime.

read.description: Glob patterns the app may read.

write.description: Glob patterns the app may write.

fs.description: File system access. Pass true to allow all paths, or restrict with glob patterns.

network.description: Network access. Pass true to allow all hosts, or restrict with allow list.

crash.description: Crash reporting — collect JS and Rust panics to ~/.glyx/crashes/.

credentials.description: Store and retrieve secrets in the OS keychain (Windows DPAPI / macOS Keychain / Linux Secret Service).

ai.description: Local AI inference — embed, generate, and transcribe via Candle (runs on-device, no API key).

audio.description: Audio playback via rodio (mp3, flac, ogg, wav).

video.description: Video playback and recording via the media pipeline.

updater.description: Over-the-air updates. Enables updater.checkManifest() for manifest-based JS-only updates, updater.downloadJs() for staged bundle delivery, and updater.check()/updater.update() for GitHub Release binary updates.

system.description: System information (OS version, CPU, memory, disk).

mdns.description: mDNS / Bonjour service discovery on the local network.

scheme.description: URL scheme to register (e.g. 'myapp' for myapp:// links).

singleInstance.description: Focus the existing window instead of launching a new instance when a deep link is opened.

deeplink.description: Register a custom URL scheme for deep links (e.g. myapp://open?id=123).

splash.description: Splash screen shown while the app loads.

image.description: Path to splash screen image (PNG/JPG). Centered on the background.

minimumMs.description: Minimum duration to show the splash in milliseconds (useful to prevent flash on fast loads).

entry.description: JS/JSX/TSX entry file for bun build.

output.description: Output bundle path (read by the glyx runtime).

watch.description: Extra directories to watch for HMR (the entry's directory is always watched).

plugins.description: JS plugin extensions. Each plugin's exported async functions become callable via `backend.<name>.<fn>()` from the React side.

entry.description: Path to the plugin entry file (JS/TS). Bundled by bun at app startup.

name.description: Optional namespace. If set, all exports are called as `backend.<name>.<fn>()`. If omitted, exports are flat: `backend.<fn>()`. Use a name when you have multiple plugins to avoid conflicts.

capabilities.description: Capability declarations for tooling/docs (not enforced at runtime — the plugin runs in the same V8 context and has access to all registered framework capabilities).
